description: The article works within an argument-based approach to validity, in which the chain of assumptions and inferences connecting test scores to interpretations and uses is made explicit.
title: Chain of assumptions/inferences perspective within an argument-based approach to validity

description: A methodology in which a procedure is first broken down using activities from psychometrically validated evaluation checklists, represented graphically in BPMN with tasks, sequence flows and gateways, then enriched and validated by a Delphi expert panel.
title: Checklist-based BPMN modelling with Delphi consensus for procedural skill breakdown
